title: Catalog Launch Rehearsal & Coordination Manifest for Model Additions
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Purpose: Drive a repeatable, low-risk launch routine for adding new models to the catalog that coordinates benchmarks, docs, release notes, and outward comms. This ticket defines the rehearsal checklist (dry-run) and gating criteria before flip-to-public. Scope: one model addition or model-variant entry (catalog metadata, sample benchmarks, docs, SDK snippet, release notes, internal playbook). Out of scope: full product marketing campaign and enterprise contract negotiation (handled separately).
checklist: Catalog metadata: validate model name, version, license, tags, and checksum in the staging catalog entry
Benchmarks: run smoke and regression benchmarks (latency p95, tokens/sec, quality suite) and upload results to eval dashboard
Docs: create or update docs page with API examples, SDK snippets, and migration notes; pair with a one-paragraph release summary
Release notes: draft user-facing release notes and internal TL;DR for sales/SEs; include known limitations and recommended configs
Console: verify visibility in Console model catalog, sample token cost estimate, and default rollout policy
SDK integ: run quick integration test with JS and Python SDK samples against staging endpoint
Observability: validate per-model metrics, tracing instrumentation, and cost telemetry in staging
Security & Compliance: confirm no PII in sample prompts; verify KMS/role access for private deployments if applicable
Rehearsal: run a full dry-run (PM, Eng, Design, Docs) where each owner walks through publishing steps
Communication: prepare announcement copy for blog/press, support KB article, and internal playbook; schedule publication window
acceptance_criteria: Staging catalog entry passes metadata validation checklist
Benchmarks show no regression >10% vs baseline for latency and throughput or have documented mitigations
Docs and SDK snippets published as PRs and linked from the staging catalog entry
Release notes draft approved by PM and Legal and staged for publication
At least one end-to-end integration test in staging completes successfully
Rehearsal completed with sign-off from Eng, DX, Docs, and GTM leads
timeline: 2025-11-20: final sign-offs and embargoed release packaging
rehearsal_plan: Kickoff (15m): PM outlines scope, rollback plan, and success metrics
Benchmarks review (20m): Engineering presents smoke results, tail cases, and mitigations
Docs walk-through (15m): Docs owner demonstrates API examples and SDK snippets
Console/UX check (10m): Design validates catalog presentation and cost callouts
Operational run (20m): SRE simulates traffic profile and verifies metrics & alerts
Comms rehearsal (10m): GTM practices announcement cadence and support brief
Sign-off (5m): capture explicit accept/reject from each stakeholder and next steps
release_notes_snippet: New model: {model-name} v{version} — improved throughput for short prompts; recommended for chat and summarization. See limitations and recommended config in docs. Contact support for Dedicated/private deployment inquiries.
